title: Sleepy mermaid
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- hair -->
  <path d='M32,30 Q28,45 32,58 Q35,66 42,66 Q38,52 40,40 Z' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <path d='M68,30 Q72,45 68,58 Q65,66 58,66 Q62,52 60,40 Z' fill='#7b3fa0'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='15' fill='#f7c9a8'/>
  <!-- hair top -->
  <path d='M35,40 Q34,24 50,24 Q66,24 65,40 Q62,30 50,30 Q38,30 35,40 Z' fill='#8e4fb8'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M41,41 Q44,44 47,41' stroke='#5b2a72' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53,41 Q56,44 59,41' stroke='#5b2a72' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='3' fill='#f39bab'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='48' r='3' fill='#f39bab'/>
  <!-- little mouth -->
  <path d='M48,50 Q50,52 52,50' stroke='#a8606e' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <path d='M40,56 Q50,53 60,56 L60,72 Q50,76 40,72 Z' fill='#f7c9a8'/>
  <!-- shell bra -->
  <path d='M41,60 Q45,56 49,60 Q45,64 41,60 Z' fill='#39c6c0'/>
  <path d='M51,60 Q55,56 59,60 Q55,64 51,60 Z' fill='#39c6c0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M40,71 Q30,80 38,88 Q46,94 50,86 Q54,94 62,88 Q70,80 60,71 Q50,75 40,71 Z' fill='#2fd08a'/>
  <!-- tail fin tips -->
  <path d='M38,88 Q30,92 33,96 Q40,94 44,90 Z' fill='#1fa86c'/>
  <path d='M62,88 Q70,92 67,96 Q60,94 56,90 Z' fill='#1fa86c'/>
  <!-- tail scales -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='80' r='2' fill='#7cf0b8'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#7cf0b8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='76' r='1.6' fill='#7cf0b8'/>
  <!-- arm -->
  <path d='M40,60 Q33,66 34,72' stroke='#f7c9a8' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M72,30 h6 l-6,6 h6' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M74,20 h4 l-4,4 h4' stroke='#8fd8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
